meaning:
κυριότης, -ητος, ἡ
(κύριος),
lordship, dominion: Eph.1:21, 2Pe.2:10, Ju 8; pl., Col.1:16 (cf. Lft., Col; Mayor, Ju., in ll.; DB, i, 616 f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or…
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
